remarks:
Welcome to 3710 Cowing Road, Lakewood, NY, a beautifully maintained country property situated on approximately 5 picturesque acres in Southwestern Central School District. Offering 5 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, this spacious home combines privacy, comfort, and scenic country living while remaining conveniently close to area amenities.

Step inside to a beautifully updated kitchen featuring white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and wonderful views overlooking the rolling countryside and peaceful pond. The home provides plenty of space for everyday living and entertaining.

Upstairs, you will find five bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite featuring a beautifully updated private bathroom with a custom vanity, soaking tub, separate stand up shower, and an impressive walk in closet.

Additional highlights include a radiant heating system and newer windows throughout the home, providing year round comfort and energy efficiency. Outside, enjoy the peaceful setting from the covered front porch or entertain on the expansive back deck while taking in the surrounding acreage and views.

A detached two bay garage provides excellent space for vehicles, storage, hobbies, or a workshop. With approximately 5 acres, a pond, beautiful country views, generous living space, and a desirable Southwestern School District location, this unique property offers the space and setting you have been looking for. A must see to truly appreciate everything 3710 Cowing Road has to offer!
